verdict.rationale: Plaid's Balance product is documented as returning real-time balance information, which is one form of getting now-fresh data on demand. The evidence shows no general refresh endpoint for other data such as transactions; transactions stay current through webhooks, which is push-based rather than developer-triggered. Missing for 10: a documented on-demand refresh API call for connected account data beyond balance, documented refresh semantics (timing, async completion, rate limits), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented

citations.quote: Balance is Plaid's product for receiving real-time balance information.
